processes.sitara_deal_ticket_correction: Logistics or accounting asks the desk to create, change, split, extend, release or reverse a Sitara deal ticket (meter, price, entity, dates) and then confirms it.
processes.deal_price_discrepancy_resolution: A price on a deal is missing, wrong or disputed against an invoice or counterparty, and someone verifies it and fixes the deal or answers the counterparty.
processes.meter_volume_missing_deal_resolution: Volumes flowed at a meter with no valid deal or an expired deal, so logistics asks for a new or extended deal or approval to write off to unaccounted-for gas.
processes.meter_allocation_variance_fix: Allocations or variances at a meter are wrong (volume on the wrong contract, imbalance), and volume management or schedulers are asked to move, zero out or list them.
processes.supplier_nomination_change_relay: Producer or customer nomination changes and estimates are received and forwarded or confirmed for the desk to set up.
processes.pipeline_operations_notice_relay: Pipeline outages, shut-ins, storage and supply changes are relayed to desk staff so they can adjust nominations.
